author: James McCarthy (1853–1919)
credit: Pantip - https://pantip.com/topic/38106682 (Original map source: James McCarthy, Surveying and exploring in Siam, 1900)
description: Chiang Mai City map of 1900. The city was also called Chiengmai in Thailand. The front of the temple faces east on the newly built Chang Moi Road, where Mae Kha Canal flows through. Along the second city wall, there is a tower at the corner of the city. The outer city wall was built from the southwest of the city along the Mae Kha Canal to the northeast.
